steps.player: What do you need?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Now that our base of operations is no longer safe, we're going to need to relocate before the vyrewatch descend on us.

steps.player: Seems like a wise move. What part do I play?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: To the south of Mort'ton there's an old town known as Burgh de Rott. The place was abandoned but I hear some escapees from Meiyerditch have made their home there.

steps.player: And you want me to scout the place out?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Exactly. Head down to Burgh de Rott and see if you can find a suitable place for our new hideout. While you're there, do what you can to forge a good relationship with the townspeople.

steps.player: I'll get it done.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Be sure to take a weapon of silver with you. You'll find it of great use if vampyres attack. Good luck to you.

steps.player: Sorry. I'm not interested.

steps.player: What should I do now?

steps.text: Well, the bank is all fixed now, but it isn't going to serve people all on its own. You'll have to recruit someone!

steps.player: Do you fancy the job?

steps.speaker: Cornelius
steps.text: Me? Why, I guess I could... Yes, in fact, I'm sure I could!

steps.speaker: Cornelius
steps.text: I'd best go and get changed now...
Cornelius gets changed into some more suitable attire and stands behind the bank booth.

entering-burgh-de-rott-fixing-the-furnac.text: There's a large hole in the chimney of the furnace which is probably why it doesn't work.

steps.text: If the player does not have the items to fix the hole:
You do not have the required items to do that. You need a hammer and 2 steel bars.
If the player does have the items to fix the hole:
You use some steel bars to fix the hole in the furnace chimney.

entering-burgh-de-rott-fixing-the-furnac.text: The furnace has been repaired now. However, it needs some fuel before it can be used.

steps.text: If the player does not have the items to fuel the furnace:
You need some coal to refuel the furnace.
If the player does have the items to fuel the furnace:
You place some coal into the newly fixed furnace.

entering-burgh-de-rott-fixing-the-furnac.text: The furnace has been repaired and refueled. It just needs lighting now.

steps.text: If the player does not have the items to light the furnace:
You need a tinderbox to light the furnace.
If the player does have the items to light the furnace:
You light the furnace...
The screen fades to black
Continues in next section.

entering-burgh-de-rott-fixing-the-furnac.speaker: Citizen
entering-burgh-de-rott-fixing-the-furnac.text: Hello there. Thank you so much for all of your work so far. We all really appreciate it.

steps.text: If speaking to Cornelius:

steps.speaker: Cornelius
steps.text: I'm Cornelius. I run the bank now.

options.text: What do you think of your town?

steps.player: What do you think of your town?

steps.speaker: Citizen
steps.text: Oh it's brilliant, but we could really do with somewhere to melt down the local ores. Maybe you could fix up the furnace?

options.text: Why does everyone stay in this town?

steps.player: Why does everyone stay in this town?

steps.speaker: Citizen
steps.text: It's safer here than anywhere else in Morytania. I guess we could try and escape across the Salve but those horrible ghasts in Mort Myre would probably just eat us alive!

steps.player: What should I do now?

steps.speaker: Citizen
steps.text: You've already done quite a lot and we're all super grateful. That said, I overheard someone saying how great it would be if the old furnace were up and working again.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

at-castle-drakan.text: The screen fades in from black, at Castle Drakan

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Gadderanks
at-castle-drakan.text: My lord... We've finished our latest round of tithing. I'm afraid we haven't been able to collect the desired amount.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
at-castle-drakan.text: I saw your wife today, Gadderanks. She's well.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
at-castle-drakan.text: I hope she stays that way.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Gadderanks
at-castle-drakan.text: My lord Vanstrom, there are precious few human settlements left worth collecting tithes from.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Gadderanks
at-castle-drakan.text: Mort'ton is just a dead town, full of afflicted. Lord Malak was so ill when he drank of them last time.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Gadderanks
at-castle-drakan.text: Canifis is delivering more than expected but that still isn't sufficient.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Gadderanks
at-castle-drakan.text: Please, where should I get the remainder from?

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
at-castle-drakan.text: I couldn't care less for your problems Gadderanks. Just do the job you've been appointed to do.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
at-castle-drakan.text: Wait... Do you smell that? Smoke. It's coming from Burgh de Rott.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Gadderanks
at-castle-drakan.text: But Burgh de Rott is abandoned.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
at-castle-drakan.text: No. Burgh de Rott was abandoned. That is clearly no longer the case.

at-castle-drakan.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
at-castle-drakan.text: It seems you have a fresh appointment, Gadderanks. I hope there will be no more delay.

gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-spea.speaker: Aurel
gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-spea.text: Well done big shot! The smoke from the furnace attracted Gadderanks and his juvinates!
If speaking to any other citizen:

steps.speaker: Citizen
steps.text: Well done big shot! The smoke from the furnace attracted Gadderanks and his juvinates. They've set up a blood tithing station in the general store!

steps.player: Who's Gadderanks?

steps.speaker: Citizen
steps.text: He's some human lackie for the vampyres. His job is to collect blood tithes from all the villages around here. He goes around with his juvinate bodyguards because he's too weak to defend himself.

steps.player: What's a juvinate?

steps.speaker: Citizen
steps.text: A form of vampyre. They're stronger than juveniles but not as bad as a full-blown vyre. Still, no one that I've seen has ever gotten the better of one.

steps.player: What should I do now?

steps.speaker: Citizen
steps.text: If I were you, I'd get out of town. Now that Gadderanks is here, I doubt many people will stay around!

steps.player: Maybe I can stop him.

steps.text: If speaking to Aurel:

steps.speaker: Aurel
steps.text: Ha! In your dreams. He's right here if you want to give it a go. It's your funeral though!
If speaking to any other citizen:

steps.speaker: Citizen
steps.text: Ha! In your dreams. He's set up in the general store if you want to give it a go. It's your funeral though!

options.condition: If has not chosen any other dialogue options yet:

steps.player: Oh, sorry.
Okay, thanks.

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: Oh happy days! It's so good we found all these specimens here! If it hadn't been for some good soul lighting that furnace, we'd have never come down here!

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: Now I should be able to make my blood tithe quota... especially after you pay your tithe. You look like an incredibly fit specimen!

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: I bet you could pay twice as much as the others before passing out!

steps.player: I don't have any intentions of paying a blood tithe!

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: Ha! We'll see about that!

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: Do I need to explain it all again? Stand in line ready to pay your blood tithe!

steps.speaker: Vampyre Juvinate
steps.text: We're getting some delicious blood tithes from these sacks of food. Yum!

steps.speaker: Vampyre Juvinate
steps.text: You deaf? We're getting some delicious blood tithes from these sacks of food.

gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.speaker: Wiskit
gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.text: They're draining my blood, that's what they're doing!

gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.speaker: Gadderanks
gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.text: I've had enough of you poking your nose in here! If you think you can stop us, go ahead!
The screen fades to black; Gadderanks and the Vampyres attack

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Fear not my friend! I will come to your aid!

gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.text: After defeating both Vampyres and Gadderanks:

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: cough*

steps.speaker: Veliaf
steps.text: Huh, it looks like Gadderanks is still alive. Perhaps he's ready to give us some information before he meets his maker.

steps.player: You don't look too well, Gadderanks. Against my better judgement, I feel sorry for you.

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: You... You do?

steps.player: Yes, I do. I understand that you wanted to feel strong, but you took the wrong side.

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: But... you don't understand. I just didn't want my family... I wanted to keep them safe.

steps.player: You need to take a second and think of them then. Think of why you did this in the first place. All of that will count for nothing if you don't help us!

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: Then... will you do me a favour? Please, try to save them. Please! I beg you!

steps.player: You have my word. If we find them, we'll take care of them.

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: Thank you. I have some information which may help you...

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: They fear some things. Silver dust and garlic to name a couple. Also outlawed are *cough* -ralander and *cough* -ders eggs. The potion which you make with them is also forbidden.

steps.player: Take it easy Gadderanks. Let's see if we can sort you out.

steps.speaker: Gadderanks
steps.text: It's too late for me *cough*. Though with what I've told you *cough*, perhaps you can find a way to *cough* bring light to Morytania.
Gadderanks passes away.

steps.speaker: Aurel
steps.text: Hey there! Gadderanks dropped this warhammer, I guess it belongs to you now!
Aurel gives you Gadderanks' Warhammer.

gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.player: Phew! Thanks for your help Veliaf. It sure was good of you to turn up.

gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.speaker: Veliaf
gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.text: Don't mention it. Have you had any luck with finding us a new hideout?

gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.player: I have. The cellar of the inn here should work perfectly.

gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.speaker: Veliaf
gadderanks-arrives-at-burgh-de-rott-at-t.text: Excellent! Now, I must return to the Hollows. Please, meet me there so we can arrange getting everyone down here safely.
Veliaf heads back to the Hollows.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: Well met, friend. Glad you made it back in one piece.

at-the-myreque-hideout.player: The priest at Paterdomus? Yes, I've helped him out before.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: Ah, excellent. Well Drezel is an old friend and he's agreed to do us a favour. Ivan is too young and inexperienced to be out here with us. He also aspires to be a priest himself.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: Drezel has agreed to take him in and train him. Once he is older and wiser, he can rejoin our fight as a spiritual advisor.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: Myself, Polmafi and Radigad will soon be heading down to Burgh de Rott. While we do so, I'd appreciate it if you could escort Ivan to Paterdomus.

at-the-myreque-hideout.player: I'm sure I can manage that.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: Thank you. There's something else I could use your help with as well.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: I'm sure you've noticed by now that our weapons have limited use against the vampyres. Even weapons made of silver only go so far. If we're to have any hope of beating their kind, we'll need to address this problem.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: If you've met Drezel, then I've no doubt that he's told you the tale of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the Salve and saved Misthalin.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: Well I have heard rumour that one of these warriors, a man called Ivandis Seergaze, used a weapon of great power against the vampyres. I have also heard that he isn't actually buried at Paterdomus with the others.

at-the-myreque-hideout.player: I see. And you'd like me to look into this?

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: If you could, my friend, you would have my gratitude. Drezel will likely know more, though I find he isn't always forthcoming where rumours are involved.

at-the-myreque-hideout.player: I'll see what I can dig up.

at-the-myreque-hideout.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
at-the-myreque-hideout.text: Before you go, do you mind telling Polmafi and Radigad that it's time for us to depart.

steps.player: Hello again.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well met. Do you need something?

options.text: What do I need to do now?

steps.player: What do I need to do now?

steps.text: If the player has not spoken to Polmafi and Radigad:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: First, let Polmafi and Radigad know that it's time for us to depart. After you've done that, please could you escort Ivan to Paterdomus.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Once you're there, Drezel might be able to help you with this Ivandis business.
If the player has spoken to Polmafi and Radigad:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Please could you escort Ivan to Paterdomus. Once you're there, Drezel might be able to help you with this Ivandis business.

options.text: What do you make of what Gadderanks said?

steps.player: What do you make of what Gadderanks said?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: It could be a load of rubbish, but it may be worth looking into. I recognise at least two of the items he mentioned as ingredients for a potion.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: The mention of garlic and silver is interesting though. We know vampyres are weak to both. The way he talked though suggests they could be used in a potion as well.

steps.player: How would I test that?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: A good question my friend, but I have no answer for you. Perhaps you could experiment?

options.text: Why does Ivan need to go to Paterdomus?

steps.player: Why does Ivan need to go to Paterdomus?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: He'll be safer there under the eye of Drezel. Drezel can help him further his spiritual skills so that when he is older and wiser, he can rejoin the fight.

steps.player: Tell me more about Ivandis.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Long ago, the Seven Priestly Warriors drove the vampyre forces out of Misthalin and blessed the Salve so that they'd never be able to return.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Now, the priests of Saradomin would have you believe that all seven are buried beneath Paterdomus. However, I have heard rumour that one of the warriors, Ivandis Seergaze, is actually buried elsewhere.

steps.player: So where is he buried instead?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: He supposedly led countless charges into Morytania and ultimately perished somewhere within these lands. If that is the case, his followers would likely have buried him near the place he died.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: The reason this is important is because it is said that Ivandis wielded a weapon of great power against the vampyres. If he died in Morytania, this weapon may have been buried with him.

options.condition: If has not chosen any other dialogue options yet:

steps.player: I'd best be off.
Okay, thanks.
Hey. Veliaf says it's time to head down to the new hideout in Burgh de Rott. Could you let Radigad know as well? I'm taking Ivan to Paterdomus.

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: Okay. Thanks for letting me know. I'll tell Radigad.

steps.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm just getting my stuff together before leaving. Good luck with your trip to the temple.

steps.player: Hey. Veliaf says it's time to head down to the new hideout in Burgh de Rott. Could you let Polmafi know as well? I'm taking Ivan to Paterdomus.

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: Okay. Thanks for letting me know. I'll tell Polmafi.

steps.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm just getting my stuff together before leaving. Good luck with your trip to the temple.

at-the-myreque-hideout-ivan.text: If the player has not spoken to Polmafi and Radigad:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Hey there. I hear you're going to be taking me to the temple.

steps.player: That's right. I just need to speak with Polmafi and Radigad and then we'll head off.

at-the-myreque-hideout-ivan.text: If the player has a pet following them or in their inventory

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.

at-the-myreque-hideout-ivan.text: If the player has spoken to Polmafi and Radigad:

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-giving-ivan.text: If the player uses a Steel [med helm/chainbody/platelegs] on Ivan:

steps.text: If Ivan doesn't have one yet:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Thanks for the [helmet/chainbody/steel legs]! That's great! It's going to help a lot! I'm going to wear it under my normal clothes.
If Ivan already has one:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Thanks for the offer of [a helmet/a chainbody/some platelegs], but you've already given me [one/some]!

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-giving-ivan.text: If the player uses any other armour on Ivan:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Thanks for the kind offer of some armour, but I can only wear a steel medium helm, steel chainbody and steel platelegs.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-giving-ivan.text: If the player uses a Silver sickle on Ivan:

steps.text: You offer the sickle to Ivan.

steps.player: You might find this sickle helpful on our travels.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Many thanks friend, I shall endeavour to wield it as bravely as Veliaf and yourself!

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-giving-ivan.text: If the player uses a piece of food on Ivan:

steps.text: Would you like to offer Ivan all of this food type in your inventory?

options.text: Yes, I'll offer all of this food item in my inventory to Ivan.
Nope, I'll just given him one.

steps.text: You hand over some food to Ivan. His eyes light up when he sees it!
If Ivan can carry more food:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Ohh delicious, some food! I'll keep that for the trip. I could carry another [number] bits of food.
If Ivan can't carry more food:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Ohh delicious, some food! I'll keep that for the trip. I'm totally stocked up with food now, thanks!

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-giving-ivan.text: If the player uses a different type food on Ivan:

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Thanks for the kind offer of food, but my favourites are either cooked snails, salmon, slimy eel or stew!

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-talking-to-.speaker: Ivan Strom
escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-talking-to-.text: Hey there. I hear you're going to be taking me to the temple.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-talking-to-.player: That's right. We should get going soon.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-talking-to-.speaker: Ivan Strom
escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-talking-to-.text: Very well. I'm ready, lead the way.
Player decides which path to take to Paterdomus

steps.text: You decide to take the route through Canifis.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-talking-to-.speaker: Vamp Juvinate
escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-talking-to-.text: There's that tasty morsel Ivan! Time for some food...

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Let's get of this place... I'm scared!

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Did those vampyres say they wanted to 'eat' me?

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-when-ivan-e.text: Ivan : Urgh, just had too eat some food, I only have [number] left.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-using-food-.speaker: Ivan Strom
escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-using-food-.text: Food is the very last thing on my mind right now... let's get out of here!

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-if-ivan-tak.speaker: Ivan Strom
escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-if-ivan-tak.text: I'm getting badly beaten up here, I'm going to die here if I stay...see you back at the old base.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-escaping-fr.text: You manage to escape from the rest of the vampyre juvinates and continue on your journey.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-after-finis.text: You manage to slay the rest of the vampyre juvinates and continue on your journey.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-after-finis.speaker: Ivan Strom
escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-after-finis.text: Many thanks for bringing me safely to the temple. I'm going to rush on ahead as I'm eager to get out of these muddy clothes.

escorting-ivan-to-paterdomus-after-finis.player: Not a problem. I need to chat to Drezel about some things. I'll see you later.

asking-drezel-about-ivandis.speaker: Drezel
asking-drezel-about-ivandis.text: Greetings again adventurer. How go your travels in Morytania? Is it as evil as I have heard?

asking-drezel-about-ivandis.speaker: Drezel
asking-drezel-about-ivandis.text: Well done for bringing Ivan to the temple, [player name]. He will be much safer here.

asking-drezel-about-ivandis.player: Yes, it seems to be more dangerous in Morytania doesn't it?

asking-drezel-about-ivandis.speaker: Drezel
asking-drezel-about-ivandis.text: Indeed it does my friend. But thanks to you and the Myreque, we have at least the hope of finding salvation in this dark and oppressive land.

steps.player: Veliaf told me about Ivandis.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Hmmm, how can I say this diplomatically. Veliaf is a good leader, but perhaps he shouldn't be voicing ideas about religious history.

steps.player: But you don't even know what he said about Ivandis.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: I assume he's made suggestions that Ivandis isn't actually buried in this temple? If he has made such a claim, it's not something I'm prepared to talk about.

options.text: So, you're sure that Ivandis is buried here then?

steps.player: So, you're sure that Ivandis is buried here then?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: If you don't mind me saying, that is a bit of a redundant question. All of the Seven Priestly Warriors are buried here, including Ivandis.

steps.player: So where did this rumour that he's buried elsewhere come from then?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Rumours come from all kinds of places. They are rarely true. I am sorry to be so blunt, but I'm offended that you challenge me on this.

options.text: What proof do you have that Ivandis is buried here?

steps.player: What proof do you have that Ivandis is buried here?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Servants of Saradomin are not concerned with triffling matters such as proof. We have our faith, and our faith guides us.

steps.player: So you don't actually know for sure that he is buried here?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Please, do not challenge me on matters of faith.

options.text: What do you know about the history of this temple?

steps.player: What do you know about the history of this temple?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: I know that it is built on the site where the Seven Priestly Warriors defended Misthalin against the evil vampyres. I also know that their sanctified and holy remains rest peacefully beneath us.

steps.player: Have you checked that then? Have you seen their remains with your own eyes?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Why would I need to? You'd have me dig up their blessed remains? For what?

options.text: Is there somewhere that I might get more information on Ivandis?

steps.player: Is there somewhere that I might get more information on Ivandis?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: What little information there is, is probably already known to you.

steps.player: So you have no further information on him that could possibly help me? Anything you know might be of use in freeing the poor people of Morytania.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: I have told you all I know. That is as much as I, or anyone, can do.
If the player didn't exhaust other dialogue options:

options.text: Will you let me check Ivandis' tomb?

steps.player: Will you let me check Ivandis' tomb?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Absolutely not! What a disgrace that you should even ask! He rests pure and undisturbed beneath this hallowed earth!

steps.player: We need to consider every possible thing which could help us!

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: I don't see how that can help you! And if you continue in this vein, it will certainly hinder you for you shall not have my support!

options.text: Why are you so resistant to talking about history?

steps.player: Why are you so resistant to talking about history?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: I am not resistant at all, my friend. I would happily talk history with you for as long as you desire. You do not wish to speak of history though, just rumours.

steps.player: I think you're holding something back! We really need all the help we can get!

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: I understand that my friend, but digging up the remains of saintly heroes will not aid us in any way!

options.text: The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!

steps.player: The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: And you know I would do anything to help those people.

steps.player: I know. So please, help me as much as you can.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Very well, but there is only so much I can do. Remember that I am still a priest of Saradomin.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: I know not if it will help, but please take this key. It will allow you access to a secret library here in the mausoleum. In there you may find what you're looking for, but I pray you never reveal this to me.
Drezel gives you a key.
Temple library key

steps.player: Thank you, Drezel.

options.text: Very well then. Morytania is lost to ignorance.

steps.player: Very well then. Morytania is lost to ignorance.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Not ignorance my friend. There are ways to save Morytania from the vampyres. This is not one of them.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

asking-drezel-about-ivandis-talking-to-d.player: Thanks very much for your help. I really appreciate it.

asking-drezel-about-ivandis-talking-to-d.speaker: Drezel
asking-drezel-about-ivandis-talking-to-d.text: I just hope that all our sacrifices are worth it.

asking-drezel-about-ivandis-searching-th.text: You inspect the panel. It looks like there's some sort of keyhole in it.
If the trapdoor is not open:

steps.text: You use the library key in the keyhole and you hear a click to the left of you.

asking-drezel-about-ivandis-searching-th.text: Searching the bookcases, depending on which:
You find a book called Histories of the Hallowland.
You find a book called Modern day Morytania.
You find a book called The Sleeping Seven.

rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.text: Hey there. It's great of you to do all this work for Veliaf. I've heard him say some good things about you. Keep up the good work and I'm sure you'll be invited to become a full member of the Myreque!

rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.text: Thanks for doing such good work on the new hideout. Of course, we've tidied up a bit as you can see.

rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.text: Thanks for getting Ivan to Paterdomus safely. Let me know if you have any luck finding information on Ivandis.

options.text: I've found a library under Paterdomus.

steps.player: I've found a library under Paterdomus.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well that can only be good news. I imagine it will contain all sorts of useful information. Do let me know if you find anything in there of note.

options.text: Do you know where Ivandis' tomb could be?

steps.player: Do you know where Ivandis' tomb could be?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well if I knew where it was, I'd be there now.

steps.player: Well yeah, but maybe you have a rough idea.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I suspect he is buried somewhere in Morytania. He supposedly led countless charges into these lands and ultimately perished while doing so.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: As for where in Morytania, I can't imagine he'd have made it too far from Paterdomus.

options.text: What do you know about Ivandis?

steps.player: What do you know about Ivandis?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Ivandis Seergaze was one of the Seven Priestly Warriors. Along with the other six, he managed to hold back the vampyres when they attempted to invade Misthalin.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: The seven of them were also responsible for blessing the Salve, preventing the vampyres from ever crossing.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: It is said that Ivandis wielded a great weapon against the vampyres. One that could render them immobile for a short time.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: There are also stories that credit him with the restoring of something called 'Guthix balance'.

steps.player: Guthix? Interesting.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Indeed. As the god of balance, it is said that Guthix will always try to ensure that both Saradomin and Zamorak do not gain an upper hand against the other.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Now, why a Saradominist warrior-priest is connected to him, I couldn't say.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: I think I've found Ivandis' tomb.

steps.player: I think I've found Ivandis' tomb.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: That's great news! Hopefully you can find something of use in there.

steps.player: There's just a coffin from what I can tell. There's some sort of rod fused to the top of it though.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: A rod you say? This sounds like it could be the weapon we seek.

steps.player: I suspect it is. I don't think there's any way to remove it though.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I hope you are wrong about that. If we cannot break the mould of our historical defeats, we will never be able to stop Drakan.

options.text: What do you know about Ivandis?

rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.player: I think I've found Ivandis' tomb.

rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.text: That's great news! Hopefully you can find something of use in there.

rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.player: Well, there's a coffin with some sort of rod fused to the top of it.
I don't think the rod can be removed. However, I made a clay mould of it so I might be able to make a new one.

rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
rod-of-ivandis-at-the-new-myreque-hideou.text: Excellent work. Let me know how it goes.

options.text: Do you know which metal I should use to make the rod?

steps.player: Do you know which metal I should use to make the rod?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I do not, I'm afraid. You mentioned that the original rod is still in Ivandis' tomb though. I'm sure studying it will give you a clue as to how it was made.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: If that doesn't work, you might be able to learn something at Paterdomus.

options.text: Do you know what the rod does?

steps.player: Do you know what the rod does?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I believe this rod is the weapon that Ivandis used against the vampyres. The stories say that he used to render them immobile for a short time. You might be able to learn more at Paterdomus.

options.text: What do you know about Ivandis?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well met. How's it going?

steps.player: I have brought you the Rod of Ivandis!

steps.text: Before enchanting or blessing the rod:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Hmm, well it certainly looks very authentic. But there doesn't seem to be any enchantment on it, either mortal or devine. Perhaps there is a step of the process you have not completed yet?
After enchanting the rod:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Hmm, well it certainly looks very authentic, and I can see it's been enchanted. But there doesn't seem to be any divine blessing on the item. Perhaps there is a step of the process you have not completed yet?

steps.player: Where would I find out about the process for completing the rod?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: If the truth is anywhere, I bet it's at Paterdomus.

steps.player: Here you go. I've managed to recreate the Rod of Ivandis.

steps.text: Continues with "Hmm, well it certainly looks very authentic"

rod-of-ivandis-making-a-new-rod-ivandis-.text: There's some boards blocking the cave entrance.

steps.text: You manage to break up the boards using a hammer.

rod-of-ivandis-making-a-new-rod-ivandis-.text: It's an ancient coffin with a strange rod fused to the top. The rod gives out a mixture of both mortal and divine energies and seems to be made out of a unique silver and mithril alloy.
You use some clay to create a mould of the rod.

rod-of-ivandis-making-a-new-rod-empoweri.text: As you cast the enchantment on the rod, it seems to vibrate and glow.

steps.text: Carrying a rope:
You lower the rod into the Salve and withdraw it shortly after. It seems to glow in a rather strange way.
Not carrying a rope:
You'd lose the rod if you just dropped it down there.

rod-of-ivandis-making-a-new-rod-empoweri.text: If the rod is not enchanted:

steps.text: You lower the rod into the Salve and withdraw it shortly after. It seems to be wet, but otherwise nothing has changed.
This rod looks very similar to the rod you saw fused to the top of the coffin. However, this rod lacks both mortal and divine energies that the original gave off.
This rod looks very similar to the rod you saw fused to the top of the coffin. However, this rod lacks the divine energies that the original gave off.

rod-of-ivandis-talking-to-veliaf-with-th.player: I have brought you the Rod of Ivandis!

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Hmmm, I can't take it off your hands while you're still using it. If you want to offer it to me, you'll need to unequip it.
You give the Rod of Ivandis to Veliaf.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I... I don't believe it! You've really done it!

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well [player name], you have certainly excelled yourself in this task. I believe you may soon be true Myreque material.
(Continues in Darkness of Hallowvale)
